verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own Connector SDK lets you develop custom Python connectors and documents a workflow to "build, test, and deploy connectors", which implies testing before deployment. That is only a thin mention covering custom connectors, not pipelines in general. Nothing in the evidence shows local execution or a lightweight local destination. missing for 10: documented local run/debug mode for pipelines, a lightweight local test destination, coverage beyond custom SDK connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I run and test a pipeline locally against a lightweight destination before it touches production

citations.quote: These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
Fivetran’s Connector SDK allows you to develop a custom data connector using Python and deploy it as an extension of Fivetran.
